'''Skyrung Manufacturing''' was a shipbuilding company that was licensed by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] to build the [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|Lambda-class T-4a shuttle]]. The company's headquarters was located in the city of [[Syward]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lavisar/Legends|Lavisar]].
